content: libp2p GossipSub itself is content/topic-agnostic -- it has no built-in concept of 'networks'; isolation is entirely a convention enforced by the application layer through topic string naming. The established precedent for this is Ethereum's consensus-layer p2p spec: topic strings are '/eth2/{ForkDigest}/{Name}/{Encoding}', where a 4-byte ForkDigest domain-separates gossip by network+fork so nodes on different networks never mesh together, and per-shard/subnet topics further suffix the name as 'beacon_attestation_{subnet_id}'. This is a direct, protocol-identical precedent (same GossipSub substrate) for embedding a subnet identifier as an additional topic-name segment.
